{{Quote|Stay alert, we lost a patrol in this sector three days ago. I've also got a funny feeling about those TIEs we encountered."<br />"I know, me too. There's no way they could've gotten from the freighter to us so quickly.|[[Kirby]] and [[Rookie One]] shortly after a TIE attack near Dreighton|<ref name="Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire]]''</ref>}}
'''Dreighton''' was a desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]] littered with rocks. There was an [[Imperial mining base|Imperial facility]] located on the planet. Below it, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] built a huge network of pipe lines and mining tunnels spanning kilometers beneath the surface.

Above the planet, [[Rookie One]] and [[Kirby]] were hailed by the ''[[Corellia Star]]'' while being attacked by TIEs.

Moving to investigate, they were initially [[Battle in the Dreighton system|engaged]] by regular [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] near the planet; Soon after the first attack, thinking themselves safe, [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE Phantoms]] appeared, disabling Rookie One and destroying Kirby's B-wing.

Having no other means to escape the planet, Rookie One entered the Imperial facility and fought his way through, eventually reaching the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]] transport ''Corellia Star''. He escaped the base by flying through mining tunnels and delivered it to the Alliance fleet.
